observation: Primary Chat needs to preserve conversational memory and expose live execution intent, not only assistant outputs. Human messages must be visible with provenance; assistant replies need an explicit thinking/execution lifecycle; workers need a compact signal-age visualization and inspectable event history.

transcript.rule: Every human turn and assistant/Prometeo reply is represented in the same chronological thread.
transcript.privacy: Public GitHub projection stores PUBLIC_SAFE_SANITIZED body by default. Raw private prompt storage requires a private authenticated store/bridge and must not be silently published.
transcript.backfill: Backfill prior important turns as summaries with input_origin=CHATGPT_MANUAL_LEGACY and original_time=UNKNOWN where exact clocks are unavailable.

reply_lifecycle.rule: If the turn is nonterminal, Primary Chat always shows an animated lifecycle/status block. No silent blank footer.
reply_lifecycle.skeleton: A worker/Guide may publish a reply outline early: section slots with planned type/size/status. The UI renders animated placeholders until each section is filled. Skeleton is a plan, not fake content.

workers.ordering: most recent durable signal stays at the leading edge; older workers are pushed backward
workers.visual_age: fresh=green, aging=amber, stale=red/gray; color derives only from durable signal age
workers.interaction: tap opens worker event history with timestamps, beacon/claim/progress/return/boundary/close and source/evidence class
workers.truth_rule: Chat-visible-only events are labeled CHAT_VISIBLE_NOT_DURABLE; never merge them silently with durable evidence.

navigation.rule: Persistent bidirectional navigation: Primary Chat <-> Worker Lab <-> focused worker <-> evidence/Flow/Trace.
navigation.primary_chat_priority: Chat answer stays primary; worker health is secondary but one tap away.

speed_rules: No per-word or per-second remote API polling.
Use current bounded thread poll plus compact compiled worker projection.
Micro-timing may be captured locally and coalesced at semantic checkpoints.
Rendering placeholders/status locally must not require a new GitHub commit for every animation frame.
anti_forgetting_rule: Conversation history is part of project continuity. A successor should reconstruct what the human asked, what Prometeo answered, what route produced it, and what remained nonterminal without reading unrelated chats.
